question: Manish started his journey from point A and traveled 8 km north. Then he turned right and traveled 7 km. After that, he turned right again and traveled 5 km. Finally, he turned right once more and traveled 7 km, stopping at point P. How far (minimum distance) and in which direction should he travel to reach point A? (All turns are 90-degree turns.)
solution:
Given: 

Manish started his journey from point A and traveled 8 km north.

Then he turned right and traveled 7 km.

After that, he turned right again and traveled 5 km.

Finally, he turned right once more and traveled 7 km, stopping at point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae9b7173947bb2a4e9150fb9ab553d3c2484b321f3544085caccdc707abeef2b.png] 

So, He should travel **3 km, towards the south **travel to reach point A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
